prompt_text: What is the best AI video ad maker?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single “best” AI video ad maker — the right choice depends on what you need (AI presenters vs. templated social ads vs. product-focused dynamic creatives, languages, budget, integrations). Below are the top options by use case, with quick pros/cons and a short checklist to help you pick.

Top picks by use case

1) AI presenter / realistic avatars
- Synthesia / HeyGen / Elai.io
  - Best if you want a talking-head spokesperson from text (many languages, realistic lip-sync).
  - Pros: high quality avatars, multi-language TTS, brand/custom avatars possible.
  - Cons: cost per minute, less flexible creative animation.

2) Fast social/video-ads from templates
- Promo.com, Biteable, InVideo (now rebranded in parts), Canva Video
  - Best for quick vertical/horizontal social ads using templates and stock footage.
  - Pros: large template libraries, easy drag-and-drop, fast output, captioning.
  - Cons: less “novel” AI generation, can look templated without customization.

3) E‑commerce / dynamic creative & product ads
- Shakr, Rocketium, Viddyoze (for animated intros/effects)
  - Best for automating many variants (product feed → many ad versions).
  - Pros: scale, platform-ready formats, integrations with ad platforms.
  - Cons: more enterprise-oriented pricing for full automation.

4) Generative editing / advanced creative control
- Runway, Descript, Kapwing
  - Best for creative, generative edits, background replacement, advanced text-to-video features.
  - Pros: powerful editing + AI tools, creative freedom.
  - Cons: steeper learning curve, may need more manual work.

5) Captioning / quick tweaks / lightweight tools
- VEED, Pictory
  - Good for repurposing long-form content into short ads, automatic captions, and summaries.

Factors to evaluate
- Output formats & aspect ratios (vertical 9:16 for Reels/TikTok, 4:5/1:1 for Instagram, 16:9 for YouTube)
- Voice and language support (TTS quality, accents)
- Brand kit (logos, fonts, colors)
- Stock assets & music library quality
- Dynamic creative / feed-based capabilities (for scaling product ads)
- Integrations (Facebook/Meta Ads, Google Ads, Shopify)
- Pricing (pay-as-you-go vs. subscription; cost per video/minute)
- Trial and export limits
- Rights & licensing for stock assets and music

Recommendations
- If you want realistic AI spokespeople: try Synthesia or HeyGen (start with free trial/demo).
- If you need fast, cheap social ads from templates: try Promo.com or Canva Video.
- If you need to produce hundreds of product variants: evaluate Shakr or Rocketium.
- If you want creative/generative editing: test Runway or Descript.

If you tell me:
- your primary platform (TikTok/Meta/YouTube),
- target length and volume (single ad vs. dozens per month),
- must-have features (AI avatar, languages, automation),
I’ll recommend 2–3 specific tools and a simple test plan (what to build and compare).
